replacements.after:
\renewcommand{\epigraphflush}{center}

% Align wrapped footnote lines with the start of the footnote text.
\makeatletter
\renewcommand{\@makefntext}[1]{%
  \parindent 1em
  \noindent
  \hangindent 1.8em
  \hangafter 1
  \hb@xt@1.8em{\hss\@makefnmark}#1%
}
\makeatother
